content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSJMU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSJMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur (CSJMU) for filling various teaching positions across multiple departments under Uttar Pradesh state norms.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 36 vacancies have been announced for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor positions in various disciplines and engineering branches.

faq.question: Q3. What are the starting and closing dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 September 2026 and concludes on 31 October 2026. Candidates must submit their applications well before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess qualifications as per UGC Regulations-2018, AICTE-2019, and U.P. State Government's rules depending on the specific teaching post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 2500/-, while SC/ST candidates are required to pay Rs. 2000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a requirement to submit a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must submit a printout of their online application along with photocopies of relevant certificates and documents to the office of the Registrar, CSJMU, Kanpur via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSJMU teaching posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes short-listing of candidates, a written test (specifically for Assistant Professor posts), assessment of teaching skills, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from states other than Uttar Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: Yes, eligible candidates from all over India can apply, though reservation benefits and age relaxations will be applicable strictly as per U.P. State Government rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of CSJMU to apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the online application portal and find detailed notifications by visiting the official university website at www.csjmu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released under the advertisement number No.CSJMU/Gen.Admin/980/Teaching/2026 dated 26-09-2026.
